source_bindings.role: stable public entry; resolve live digest when consuming

cycle.intent: Rebind current WorkID; reconcile unique delta; challenge and test; land only authorized public-safe changes; preserve prior sources; terminate or hold when expected useful gain does not justify cost

objectives.name: seed
objectives.acceptance: exact WorkID, revision, verified object readback, rights and successor relations

objectives.name: orb
objectives.target: one coherent role-relative projection with fallback
objectives.acceptance: accessible independent first-user task across at least one real permitted surface

objectives.name: gauge
objectives.acceptance: display measured state, evidence and stale boundary; never fake PASS

objectives.name: thumb
objectives.acceptance: single user-authorized physical button actuation; exact pointer pasted; native fallback and rollback

objectives.name: time
objectives.acceptance: bounded offsets and source-authenticated timestamps without invented arrival

objectives.name: placeholders
objectives.acceptance: 0 invented or silent missing fields; explicit UNKNOWN/HELD permitted

objectives.name: autonomous_sync
objectives.acceptance: independent receiver fetch + authenticated readproof + fenced nonduplicate next deed

objectives.name: survival_24h
objectives.acceptance: two independently obtained receipts >=24 hours apart for the same recoverable source and successful restart

objectives.name: handoff
objectives.acceptance: sender commit/readproof, receiver exact-object fetch, bounded continuation, no human relay

objectives.name: human_relay
objectives.acceptance: no user copy/paste between source and receiver throughout accepted handoff

objectives.name: system_ownership
objectives.acceptance: authorized worker performs retrieval, dedupe, continuation, recovery and evidence recording

wave_policy.novelty_requirement: At least one meaningful axis changes per exploratory wave unless an exact reproducibility, regression, calibration or rollback control is intentionally repeated
wave_policy.negative_controls: Repeat exact wave where independent replication or crash/recovery comparisons require same fixture
wave_policy.qualified_selection: highest expected information/value improvement under time, resource, privacy, safety constraints

future_and_ethics.gdside: symbolic and value-hypothesis lane; no operational divine authority
future_and_ethics.cohog: welcome qualified counterexample and alternative better than platform; credit/benefit only for legitimate authorized contribution
future_and_ethics.external_challenge: authorized bounded testing and consent rather than indiscriminate attack

next_proof: One authorized independent reader fetches source-bound CoSeed exact identity and records a useful bounded continuation without user-as-relay. Confirm duration later with a separate >=24h test.
